The deployment helper container in the Docker network coolify on the server srv cannot connect to the Git host. The helper container can reach different hosts than the server itself, so a Docker Compose file can load (Coolify reads it on the server) while the clone fails. fatal: Could not read from remote repository.

The Git host sent an SSH host key that is not the saved or published key. This can be an attack. Ask the administrator of the Git host if the key changed.
